text: Implemented Double streamed sg, Sgg, shg, and sug reductions for 6 and 12 parameters with upper-triangle storage and a reusable workspace-backed result. The normal path materializes no projection matrix, patch Jacobian, QR, SVD, or sample-by-parameter buffer. Scale-aware diagonal, pair, scalar, and cancellation checks trigger a second explicitly centred pass. Recomputations and accepted/failed diagnostics are counted; material disagreement returns StatisticsDisagreement and never clips curvature. Explicit C/P/J parity passes for both parameter counts at 1e-10 absolute or 1e-9 relative, including a fixed patch shifted by 1e8. The cancellation falsification with derivative offset 1e12 fails explicitly. All 17 Flashalign tests pass on JVM and Scala.js.
